Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality Korean Dooit mobile UI with clear hierarchy, strong typography and purposeful spacing. One focused app screen, not a feature inventory. Target viewport 390 x 844, naturally scaled portrait at that ratio. Output only app content: no phone, bezel, status bar, browser chrome, annotations, concept title or numbered option labels. Current date anchor 2026-10-26 Monday. Example task is 토익 시험 접수, goal 토익 900점 받기, schedule 2026-10-26, 14:00–14:30, notification 시작 시각, recurrence 2주마다.
Input image 1 is the actual current basic editor, primary visual/style and proportions reference. Input image 2 is actual over-dense expanded options, evidence of problem to solve, NOT a layout to preserve. Preserve Dooit white base surface, dark navy #0F172A, secondary #4B5563, blue #1769E0, blueSoft #EFF6FF, subtle border #E2E8F0. Korean sans, body16/24, labels14/20, page title22/30. Minimum target44px. No huge fonts, nested cards, gradients or unnecessary shadows. Use spacing/grouping/alignment first, subtle dividers second, borders only for real input fields. Optical icon centering. No decorative icons or badges. Preserve goal context, edit flow and input data; do not add features. Avoid showing every possible choice together; one clear primary action.
Direction name: 현재 값만 보이는 속성 행.
Render full main editor from top: small gray handle, goal dot and 토익 900점 받기 chevron at left, X right, heading 할 일 수정; title labeled 제목 and 8/30, title field 토익 시험 접수; compact connected type selector 할 일 / 일정(selected) / 아이디어; 일정 날짜 field2026-10-26; 종일 switch off; equalwidth 시작14:00 and 종료14:30 fields.
Replace the giant expanded choices with ONLY TWO compact, clean property rows below time fields: bell icon and 알림 at left, 시작 시각 and chevron at right; repeat icon and 반복 at left, 2주마다 and chevron at right. Entire row tappable, no pill boxes around values. Thin subtle separator between these rows only. No options lists on this screen. Tapping a row will open a dedicated focused picker, but do not draw that picker here. Plain low-emphasis additional text link 설명·추가 정보 below. Footer single full-width blue 수정 완료 button, 취소 as low emphasis text above. Keep comfortable realistic spacing, do not invent a full-width huge blank space. Basic editor typography and field styles closely match reference. Primary design purpose: understand saved settings at a glance without simultaneously displaying15 choices.
